operation.source_intent: CancelClickedAsync invokes the supplied cancel callback only when the form is neither busy nor cancel-disabled, and the cancel control is rendered only when ShowCancel is true.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The source-equivalent cancel action is mounted on the real tenant-scoped WordPress Site Onboarding final step. It invokes the existing Previous-step callback only when not busy, not cancel-disabled, and not already dispatching another form action.
laravel_adaptation.authorization: The shared sync form-action control is rendered only for sites.manage (or *).

security_boundary.tenant_context: The mounted flow uses the server-authored active tenant FrontendContext and does not accept a caller-owned tenant selector.
